Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 20-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Computational Neuroscience [NPT_4130]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Describe the basic structures in the brain involved in sensory and motor functions.                    (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                       Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Explain how networks of neurons and synapses form systems of neural processing.                        (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2)                Illustrate how the patch-clamp technique is used to study ion channels and membrane potentials.        (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                        Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Analyse how the different ionic conductances and gating variables in the Hodgkin-Huxley model          (5)  
  interact to produce an action potential.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3)                Using the Morris-Lecar model, show how bifurcation analysis helps in understanding neural firing       (5)  
  patterns.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Analyze how changes in external stimuli alter the trajectory patterns in the phase-plane of a neuron (5)  
  model, and infer what this reveals about neural excitability.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Analyse how different statistical methods influence spike train discrimination and interpret their     (5)  
  impact on decoding sensory information.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Illustrate with an example how population coding improves stimulus representation in neural            (5)  
  systems.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                Analyse how different mechanisms of short-term plasticity influence neural computation and             (5)  
  information processing.  
  A)  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                Evaluate the role of long-term potentiation (LTP) and long-term depression (LTD) in learning and    (5)  
  memory.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"
